$ units check --help
Usage: units check [options]

Print the options and compare each size with the largest size.

Options:
      --max bytesize        Largest size of an upload.               default "1MB", env UNITS_CHECK_MAX, key check.max
      --origin point        Origin of the grid.                      default "0,0", env UNITS_CHECK_ORIGIN, key check.origin
      --sizes bytesize,...  Sizes to compare with the largest size.  env UNITS_CHECK_SIZES, key check.sizes
      --target celsius      Target temperature.                      default "21C", env UNITS_CHECK_TARGET, key check.target
      --version version     Lowest version of a client.              default "v1.0.0", env UNITS_CHECK_VERSION, key check.version
      --webhook url         Webhook of the alerts.                   env UNITS_CHECK_WEBHOOK, key check.webhook

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env UNITS_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ units check
max 1048576B, version v1.0.0, target 21C, origin 0,0, webhook <nil>
[exit 0]

$ units check --max 64KB --sizes 512B,1MB --version v2.3.4 --target 19.5C --origin 3,4 --webhook https://hooks.example.com/alerts
max 65536B, version v2.3.4, target 19.5C, origin 3,4, webhook https://hooks.example.com/alerts
size 512B fits
size 1048576B is too large
[exit 0]

$ units check --max 5TB
units: check: invalid --max "5TB" from flag --max: main: want a whole number with the unit B, KB, MB or GB
[exit 2]

$ units check --max 1.5MB
units: check: invalid --max "1.5MB" from flag --max: main: want a whole number with the unit B, KB, MB or GB
[exit 2]

$ units check --max 5
units: check: invalid --max "5" from flag --max: main: want a whole number with the unit B, KB, MB or GB
[exit 2]

$ units check --version 2.0
units: check: invalid --version "2.0" from flag --version: main: want a version of the form v1.2.3
[exit 2]

$ units check --version v1.x.3
units: check: invalid --version "v1.x.3" from flag --version: main: want a version of the form v1.2.3
[exit 2]

$ units check --target 70F
units: check: invalid --target "70F" from flag --target: main: want a number with the unit C
[exit 2]

$ units check --target warmC
units: check: invalid --target "warmC" from flag --target: main: want a number with the unit C
[exit 2]

$ units check --origin 3
units: check: invalid --origin "3" from flag --origin: main: want two whole numbers of the form x,y
[exit 2]

$ units check --webhook http://hooks.example.com/alerts
units: check: invalid --webhook "http://hooks.example.com/alerts" from flag --webhook: main: want a URL with the scheme https
[exit 2]

$ units check --webhook %zz
units: check: invalid --webhook "%zz" from flag --webhook: main: parse the URL: parse "%zz": invalid URL escape "%zz"
[exit 2]

$ units check >/dev/full
units: main: write the check: clitest: no space left on device
[exit 1]
